blindSpots.text: Wraparound, tables, indexes and statements are read on the primary only: an index read as unused counts primary scans, and the replicas' pg_stat_statements are not shown.
Statement text never leaves the database: the console shows the queryid, and pgAdmin shows the text.
Consumption rates, autovacuum verdicts and regressions rest on samples the console keeps in memory: they start again when the console restarts.
The console keeps each hour's costliest statements only: a statement that entered them lately has no baseline a day earlier and is not compared.
The exporter caches its custom queries for the Cluster's metricsQueriesTTL (30 s by default): a refreshed lock graph can be that old.
Multixact member space is not read: it can run out before multixact ids do, and autovacuum then freezes multixacts earlier than autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age says.
The forecasts use the configured freeze ages: PostgreSQL lowers the effective multixact freeze age on its own when member space runs short, which they do not show.
A failover or a crash recovery resets the scan and vacuum counters without setting stats_reset: an index read as unused may have been scanned before it.
An index that serves a foreign key's checks often shows no scans: it is used when referenced rows are deleted or updated, which may be rare and still need it.
The insight pack is not enabled on this Cluster, so none of these panels has data. Opt in with spec.monitoring.customQueriesConfigMap: [{name: pgtoolbox-insight-pack, key: queries}].
